toolsPreview.name: search_jobs
toolsPreview.description:
Search Indeed for job listings. Returns titles, companies, salaries, descriptions.
Args:
    query: Job title or keywords (e.g. 'software engineer')
    location: City or state (optional, e.g. 'New York')
    max_results: Max results (default 20)

toolsPreview.name: company_reviews
toolsPreview.description:
Get Glassdoor reviews for a company. Returns ratings, pros, cons, salary data.
Args:
    company: Company name (e.g. 'Google')
    max_results: Max reviews (default 20)

toolsPreview.name: salary_search
toolsPreview.description:
Search H1B visa salary data for a job title. Returns employer, salary, location.
Args:
    job_title: Job title (e.g. 'Data Scientist')
    location: City or state (optional)
